inputs.commit_message: chore: verify Local Runner host capabilities
inputs.shell_command: set -u; echo '=== LOCAL RUNNER CAPABILITY PROBE ==='; echo "user=$(id -un)"; echo "uid=$(id -u)"; echo "host=$(hostname)"; if sudo -n true 2>/dev/null; then echo 'sudo_nopasswd=yes'; echo "sudo_uid=$(sudo -n id -u)"; else echo 'sudo_nopasswd=no'; fi; if sudo -n test -r /etc/shadow 2>/dev/null; then echo 'root_read=yes'; else echo 'root_read=no'; fi; probe=/var/tmp/gova-local-runner-capability-$$; if sudo -n sh -c "umask 077; : > '$probe'" 2>/dev/null && sudo -n test -f "$probe"; then echo 'root_write=yes'; sudo -n rm -f "$probe"; else echo 'root_write=no'; fi; if test -r /home/hesham; then echo 'home_read=yes'; else echo 'home_read=no'; fi; if test -w /home/hesham; then echo 'home_write=yes'; else echo 'home_write=no'; fi; for tool in systemctl apt-get crontab ip ss git node npm python3 docker; do if command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "tool.$tool=available"; else echo "tool.$tool=missing"; fi; done; POLICY=/home/hesham/gova/.local/host-tools.json; if [ -r "$POLICY" ]; then node -e "const fs=require('fs');try{const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1],'utf8'));console.log('host_tool.antigravity_allowed='+(p?.antigravity?.allowed===true?'yes':'no'))}catch{console.log('host_tool.policy=unreadable')}" "$POLICY"; else echo 'host_tool.policy=missing'; fi; if command -v antigravity >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "tool.antigravity_path=$(command -v antigravity)"; else echo 'tool.antigravity_path=missing'; fi; if command -v agy >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "tool.agy_path=$(command -v agy)"; else echo 'tool.agy_path=missing'; fi; echo '=== END PROBE ==='
